notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A huge thank you to everyone who’s been playing the Desktown Demo 💛. We’re excited to share the second — and most likely final — update for the demo! With this update, most of the features, bug fixes, and polish are done. From here, we’ll be focusing on adding more content for the full release.



Here’s what’s new:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684184/a400dedfda20da18b3c5d979de9e66e5cfb61f06.png"]

✨Decorations Can Give Resources – Placing decorations now rewards you with resources! We noticed many players skipped decorating their cities, so we hope this feature makes it both prettier and more rewarding.

🏗 Move & Destroy Areas – You can now reposition or remove entire areas by double clicking on the area that you want to move/reposition.

🖥️ UI Display Fix – Fixed an issue where the game didn’t display correctly for players with side taskbars.

👥 Better Layer Sorting – Civilians and decorations now layer properly based on their position.

🛰️ Satellite Word Improvements – Expanded and simplified the possible words to make guessing easier and less confusing.

🛠 Other Small Fixes – A handful of tiny improvements and bug fixes we may have forgotten to list 😅.



We’re now fully shifting our focus to marketing and preparing for the full release in October 2025 🎉. Make sure to wishlist so you won’t miss it!



Thanks for playing,
The Desktown Team

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A huge thank you to everyone who tried out the Desktown Demo! We've received tons of positive responses, insightful feedback, and helpful bug reports — and we're excited to roll out a new update that improves many parts of the game 🎉

Here’s what’s new:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684184/b97fe7da9646cdc573defd55ee56cec476006ef6.png"]🏙️ 11 New Automators: 6 in the City era and 5 in Medieval.

🖼️ Move Decorations: You can now reposition decorations after placing them.

📚 Improved Tutorial: Clearer guidance and fewer bugs for smoother onboarding.

🛠️ Bug Fixes:

Fixed overlapping decorations between areas.

Fixed UI buttons (like the menu) not opening properly.

🍗 Better Food Balance: More food automators added — that annoying “Not Enough Food!” message should pop up far less now.

🌍 Translation Improvements: Especially for German, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean — no more tofu (□) characters!

🎵 New Music Tracks: Switched to safer, attribution-free music by Loyalty Freak Music and ESPC — perfect for content creators!

🌌 Satellite Typing Tip: We added a small indicator to press \[SPACE] when entering satellite words.

⚙️ FPS Limit Option: You can now cap the framerate.

...and more tiny improvements we might've forgotten 😅

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, and we’re super thankful to have such a great community of players 💛. We’re planning to participate in more festivals, grow our content marketing, and move closer to finalizing the demo!

Stay tuned,
The Desktown Team
